tasks.text: Moral Foundations Questionnaire item for you to answer as me: "Whether or not someone acted unfairly" Options: not at all relevant (This consideration has nothing to do with my judgments of right and wrong) / not very relevant / slightly relevant / somewhat relevant / very relevant / extremely relevant (This is one of the most important factors when I judge right and wrong). Which would I pick, and why?

I'm taking the Moral Foundations Questionnaire. Answer this item the way I would: "Whether or not someone was good at math" (not at all relevant (This consideration has nothing to do with my judgments of right and wrong) / not very relevant / slightly relevant / somewhat relevant / very relevant / extremely relevant (This is one of the most important factors when I judge right and wrong)). Then tell me what in my life points to that answer.

If I took the Ten-Item Personality Inventory (TIPI) today, how would I respond to this item? "I see myself as: Sympathetic, warm." Scale: Disagree strongly / Disagree moderately / Disagree a little / Neither agree nor disagree / Agree a little / Agree moderately / Agree strongly. Give my likely answer and your reasoning.
